description: This file defines the c10::Stream class, which represents a device-agnostic stream used for kernel execution and synchronization in a deep learning framework. It includes stream management, device association, and utility functions.

classes.name: c10::Stream
classes.description: A device-agnostic class representing a hardware stream for kernel execution and synchronization.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the device associated with the stream.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type of the stream.

methods.name: device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index of the stream.

methods.name: wait
methods.description: Enqueues a wait instruction in the stream's work queue.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Checks if all previously enqueued work on the stream has completed.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Blocks until all work on the stream has completed.

methods.name: hash
methods.description: Returns a packed 64-bit hash representing the stream.

methods.name: pack3
methods.description: Returns a StreamData3 struct with stream info.

methods.name: unpack3
methods.description: Creates a Stream object from stream id, device index, and device type.
